question: Which of the following dams is correctly paired with the state in which it is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hirakud dam – Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hirakud Dam Project is a multipurpose scheme intended for **flood control, irrigation, and power generation**.
 
• The dam is built across the river **Mahanadi in the state of Odisha**.
 
• This is one of the **oldest hydel projects in India**, being the first post-independence major multi-purpose river valley project in the country. 
 
• **Sir M. Visveswararya** suggested a thorough inquiry into storage reservoirs in the Mahanadi basin after the **destructive floods of 1936**, to address the issue of floods in the Mahanadi delta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/999c99338fe8d304f96d13834a9405c147840c095ffeecc54ecc4875c63e1f20.png]
